role: Foundation study bundle for SiC MOSFETs and embedded Linux
use: Separate learning claims from production-safe claims before translating theory into hardware.
hazards: High voltage, fast switching, thermal stress, layout parasitics, shock/fire risk
gate: No powered prototype claim without schematic, BOM, derating calculation, test plan, and qualified review.

use: Track corruption, brownout, level-shift, flash-write and data-integrity hazards.
hazards: Silent corruption, partial writes, floating flash pins, brownout, wrong voltage rails
gate: No trusted storage claim until power-loss and dual-manifest recovery tests pass.

use: Block fabrication release until ERC/DRC, flash bus, USB power, and enclosure safety are reviewed.
hazards: Prototype Gerbers, unverified footprints, USB serial misuse, 5V/3.3V damage
gate: No PCB order using preliminary outputs; regenerate after netlist/footprint/electrical review.

use: Separate bench/tethered test evidence from real-flight readiness.
hazards: Propellers, LiPo, motor arming, RF link loss, IMU calibration errors, uncontrolled flight
gate: No untethered flight until arming, failsafe, geofence, RF, battery, and no-prop tests pass.

use: Control leg torque, battery risk, E-stop, gait safety, and low-voltage conditions.
hazards: Pinch/contact hazards, motor torque, falls, hot actuators, battery undervoltage
gate: No walking test unless robot is on blocks first and E-stop/torque limits are verified.

use: Control outdoor power, moving axes, toolheads, irrigation and field operation risks.
hazards: Moving gantry, belts, water near electronics, outdoor weather, toolhead collision
gate: No field deployment without weatherproofing, cable routing, endstops, E-stop and safe tool rules.

role: Open-source lab microscope and precision positioning platform
use: Prevent false measurement confidence and unsupported medical/diagnostic claims.
hazards: Optical miscalibration, contamination, sample mishandling, incorrect diagnostic interpretation
gate: No diagnostic claim without calibrated optics, reference sample, repeatability evidence and regulatory review.

use: Define RF, mast, grounding, weather and receive-vs-transmit compliance boundaries.
hazards: Mast fall, lightning, outdoor cable ingress, rotator pinch, spectrum-law violation
gate: No transmit or high mast deployment without local RF permission, grounding and mechanical review.

use: Control heaters, mains/24V wiring, chamber heat, motion and print-farm safety.
hazards: Hotend/bed burns, thermal runaway, chamber heat, moving gantry, mains wiring
gate: No unattended printing until thermal runaway, wiring, grounding, fusing and chamber temperature tests pass.

use: Treat all EVSE work as mains/safety-critical; block uncertified charger claims.
hazards: Mains voltage, ground faults, stuck relay, GFCI failure, enclosure heat, EV standards noncompliance
gate: No live EV charging product without certified design review, GFCI/ground/relay tests and applicable approvals.

use: Control privacy, firmware provenance, camera flashing, credential and network exposure risks.
hazards: Video leakage, exposed credentials, bricked camera, unsafe surveillance use
gate: No deployment until local-only data path, password rotation, firmware hash and privacy notice are verified.

project: BeagleV-Fire / Milk-V Duo RISC-V edge bundle
role: RISC-V edge compute, FPGA and embedded Linux platform
use: Track firmware-image provenance, thermal/power limits, network services and peripheral-voltage risks.
hazards: Brownout, thermal throttling, untrusted images, FPGA/toolchain assumptions, exposed services
gate: No field image until boot source, hashes, services, GPIO voltage and thermal evidence are recorded.

role: Plastic recycling and small manufacturing machine ecosystem
use: Control blades, heaters, torque, fumes, mains/VFDs, guarding, and workshop safety.
hazards: Shredder blades, high torque, pinch points, hot barrels, fumes, VFD/mains wiring
gate: No public workshop use without guards, E-stop, ventilation, electrical review and operator checklist.

project: NASA JPL Rover / OpenAMRobot research bundle
role: Rover mechanics plus modern ROS2 AMR robot stack
use: Control battery, mobile robot, motor, E-stop, brownout and public-area safety hazards.
hazards: No battery fuse/disconnect in OpenAMRobot status, moving wheels, Pi brownout, software-only E-stop
gate: No mobile operation around people until physical E-stop, fuse/disconnect, speed limits and stop tests pass.
